start.title: Start and players
start.about: The first screen where a player is picked, creating a new player, importing and moving profiles, and the control buttons found all over the game.

map.title: Map and worlds
map.about: The map where the child enters the levels: its buttons, names of worlds and stories, the questions and answers after a level and secrets.

typing.title: Typing on the keyboard
typing.about: Everything the child sees and reads while typing: the level screen, the cards before play, a new key, own typing, free typing and the paw help.

story.title: Story and storytellers
story.about: The lines of the character and the fairy Melody, the short story scenes between worlds, and the lines heard while playing in each world.

aim.title: Target range
aim.about: A mini game where the character throws things at a target and the child types the words on the rings. It trains accuracy on the weaker letters.

results.title: Results and progress

wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
wardrobe.about: The screen where the child picks a character and dresses it in accessories earned by playing.

breaks.title: Breaks and tips
breaks.about: The texts of the stretch break the game offers after longer play, and the tips a child sees before a level.

settings.title: Parent settings

mentors.title: Teachers and tasks

help.title: Help and about

words.title: The word list
words.about: The everyday words of a language, from which the game builds its typing targets. They are written in one field.

common.title: Shared texts
common.about: Short texts of buttons and dialogs that appear on many screens.

start-page.title: Start screen
start-page.about: Texts of the screen where a player picks a profile, and around it.

new-profile.title: New player
new-profile.about: The form for creating a new player and the names of the characters.

import.title: Importing and moving profiles
import.about: Dialogs for loading profiles from a file, moving a player by a link, and installing the game.

worlds.title: World names
worlds.about: Short names of the 15 worlds, shown on the map, in lock hints and as music titles.

map-teacher.title: Ms Turtle's tips
map-teacher.about: Tips about the app's features that Ms Turtle the teacher now and then gives on the map, and their buttons.

map-buttons.title: Map buttons
map-buttons.about: The greeting and the buttons in the player's column on the main map.

map-page.title: The map
map-page.about: Texts of the main map: story names, level hints and hints about unlocking levels.

world-keys.title: A world's keys
world-keys.about: The window from the keyboard button on a world's card: the keys to master before the world opens, the keys it teaches and the ones already mastered.

surprise.title: Parent's secret
surprise.about: Texts about a secret that a parent prepared as a reward.

tracks.title: Music titles
tracks.about: Titles of music tracks that belong to no world.

level-pause.title: Pause
level-pause.about: The pause card in a level: a stretch tip, slower and the quick exercise.

level.title: Level screen
level.about: Buttons, tooltips, the pause card, ending a level and notices shown on the level screen.

keyboard.title: Keyboard and fingers
keyboard.about: Names of keys, keyboard layouts and fingers, and the hints on the on-screen keyboard.

keyboard-settings.title: Keyboard settings
keyboard-settings.about: The button under the on-screen keyboard with the layout and the fingering, and its small panel: layout, fingering, the on-screen keyboard and the hands.

posture.title: Get ready to type
posture.about: The card about sitting well that is shown before every level.

new-key.title: New key
new-key.about: The card told once before the first new key, the card that introduces a new key and says which finger presses it, and the home row card.

practice.title: Own typing
practice.about: Choosing keys and the way of typing for practice, and the texts shown during an exercise.

free-type.title: Free typing
free-type.about: Typing with no goal, and the notice that a real keyboard is needed.

helpers.title: Typing helpers
helpers.about: The paw help: the character types a word for the child.

journey.title: Hero's journey
journey.about: The long, harder trip through every world of a story that opens after its last world: its title, the line about it being harder and the card between its parts.

tapko.title: The character and fairy Melody
tapko.about: Lines that the character or the fairy Melody say during and after play. One line from each group is picked at random.

story-worlds.title: World stories
story-worlds.about: The story of each world, shown on the get-ready card before its first level the first time. **phrase** marks highlight a phrase in bold.

story-scenes.title: Story scenes
story-scenes.about: Short reward scenes of a few lines, shown after a world is finished.

story-space.title: Lines in the rocket world
story-space.about: Opening lines and speech bubbles of the rocket world's levels: hopping across meteors, strong meteors and commands to the rocket.

story-planet.title: Lines of the Planet world
story-planet.about: Opening lines and bubbles of the Planet world's levels: the swamp, crystals on the meadow, crossroads with signposts, spells for the crystals of life and the great swamp with the monolith.

story-valley.title: Lines of the Dragon Valley
story-valley.about: Opening lines, shouts and end lines of the valley's levels: flames for the fire pit, the overgrown path, flying lessons, the lullaby and the take-off to the crystal meadow.

story-mountain.title: Lines of the egg mountain
story-mountain.about: Opening lines, shouts and end lines of the egg mountain's levels: the wind on the slope, sticky puddles, the mountain crossroads, rolling boulders and the spell of awakening on the summit.

story-placeholder.title: Worlds still being made
story-placeholder.about: The card line, the small sign, the counter and the end line of the copying game that every level of a world not built yet plays for now.

story-paths.title: Paths at the crossroads
story-paths.about: Names of the paths on the signposts (the planet's and the mountain's), the character's lines when the child takes one, and the parts of the line about the unknown road.

story-play.title: Lines during play
story-play.about: Lines of animals, robots and the fairy shown in speech bubbles while playing the worlds.

aim-page.title: Range screens and buttons
aim-page.about: The opening rules, the hit counter, the end card after the range and the collection of rare things.

aim-lines.title: General range lines
aim-lines.about: Common lines of the target (reacting to throws) and of the character. One line of each list is picked at random.

aim-thing.title: Thing: {item}
aim-thing.about: Lines and sounds for one thing the character throws. This group shows once for every thing.

parrot.title: Parrot
parrot.about: The parrot game next to every finished world: a few words many times in a row until the fingers know them, and the Parrot badge.

end-titles.title: End card titles and buttons
end-titles.about: The one card after every end (a level, a practice, the range, the parrot, free typing, the warm-up, a finished task): its titles, the surprise band and its buttons.

end.title: End card rows and news
end.about: The rows (label and value) of the end cards, the values under their picture and the green line of news.

results.title: Results news
results.about: What the green line of an end card says: new keys, badges, medals, and the buttons after a level.

badge.title: World badges
badge.about: The bronze, silver and gold badge of each world and their tooltips.

progress-sums.title: My progress counters
progress-sums.about: The tooltips and short texts of the three rows of counters at the top of My progress: the long-term picture, the last 14 days and the totals ever.

progress.title: My progress
progress.about: The My progress page the child opens with the button on the map (a quick look by tapping the character too), and its tabs.

stats.title: My keys
stats.about: The tab with statistics for single keys, and the medals.

cert.title: Certificate
cert.about: The printable typing certificate that a parent opens from the progress overview.

super.title: Super mode
super.about: The super account service menu used to try the game out, not for normal play.

wardrobe.title: Wardrobe and character
wardrobe.about: Labels on the wardrobe screen: character picker, counters, wardrobe time and body place names.

items-head.title: Head accessories
items-head.about: Names of accessories worn on the head.

items-face.title: Face and neck accessories
items-face.about: Names of glasses, masks and neck accessories.

items-body.title: Body and back accessories
items-body.about: Names of vests, wings and capes.

items-hand.title: Hand and feet accessories
items-hand.about: Names of things held in the hand, gloves and shoes.

break.title: Stretch and big break
break.about: The break screen with short exercises, an optional big break and the skip button.

tips-body.title: Posture tips
tips-body.about: Advice on sitting, hands and rest, shown on the card before a level or in the help.

tips-keys.title: Finger and key tips
tips-keys.about: Advice on the home row, fingers and special keys. Some show only on a Slovak keyboard or only later.

tips-mind.title: Learning tips
tips-mind.about: Advice on accuracy, rhythm, patience, listening and memory. Listening tips show only for dictation, memory tips for memory runs.

parent-page.title: Entrance and tabs
parent-page.about: The question window before the settings open, the page title and the names of the tabs and groups.

parent-child.title: Student and languages
parent-child.about: Name, nickname, character, languages, keyboard and opening the translator on the Settings tab; encouragements on the Own content tab.

parent-practice.title: Practice
parent-practice.about: Difficulty, word length, help for young students, wardrobe time, play time and the finger guide.

parent-look.title: Sound and looks
parent-look.about: Volume, reading aloud, font and display aids.

parent-lock.title: Settings password
parent-lock.about: The password window before entering, and the group for setting, changing and removing the password.

parent-keys.title: Keys
parent-keys.about: Choosing active keys, automatically or by hand, with row buttons and punctuation.

parent-data.title: Data and charts
parent-data.about: Export, import and deleting a profile on the Data tab, the translate button and the own languages group; also the charts on the My progress page.

own.title: Own words and text
own.about: The Own content tab: words, text and how much of them enters the levels. The Task tab reuses some of the same fields.

surprises-form.title: Surprise form
surprises-form.about: The explanation, the form for adding or editing a surprise, and its error messages.

surprises-table.title: Surprise table
surprises-table.about: The list of surprises with the rule and state of each.

teacher-page.title: Teacher page
teacher-page.about: The main teacher screen: the three main tabs and their sub tabs, the Results tab with the recent results, and the messages after a result link was opened.

teacher-table.title: Tables and sorting
teacher-table.about: Column headers, units, counts and the CSV button of the result tables.

teacher-groups.title: Groups and sets
teacher-groups.about: The Groups tab: the group filter, the sets of results and one set on its own page.

teacher-writers.title: Students
teacher-writers.about: The Students tab with moving ticked students into a group, and one student's card.

teacher-scan.title: QR scanning
teacher-scan.about: Scanning result QR codes with the camera, and the page for pasting a result link.

teacher-files.title: .tapko files
teacher-files.about: The Files tab and the page for importing a .tapko file.

teacher-data.title: Data tools
teacher-data.about: The Data tab of the teacher page: export, import, renaming and merging groups and students, deleting, and their dialogs.

task-make.title: Making a task
task-make.about: The New task tab of the teacher page: the form for a task.

task-play.title: Doing and handing in
task-play.about: Taking a task from a link or code, the player's Tasks page, doing a task, and handing it in to the teacher.

share.title: Sharing links
share.about: The link, QR code and big code, shared by tasks and results.

help-tabs.title: Title, tabs and icons
help-tabs.about: The title of the Help page, the tab names and the descriptions of the button icons on the map and in a level.

help-games.title: Kinds of games
help-games.about: The list of game kinds in the Progress tab of Help, one line each. Keep the **bold** game names the same as on the map.

help-texts.title: Help page texts
help-texts.about: Headings and paragraphs of the Help tabs. Keep the **bold** marks in the text in your translation.

about.title: About the game and privacy
about.about: The About Tapko tab for parents: introduction, privacy, data, the visit counter and links.

words.title: A language word list
words.about: The everyday words of the new language, in one field, separated by spaces or new lines. Leave out words that cannot be typed on the chosen keyboard; the first lessons need enough words made of their few letters.

story-journey.title: Lines of the dragon story's hero's journey
story-journey.about: Shouts and end lines of the way back to the rocket: boulders on the way down, the little dragon's first flight, crystals for the rocket, the rocket on the shore and its take-off.

task-note.title: Noting a task on a phone
task-note.about: A phone without a keyboard reads a task's QR code and sends the task home to a computer.

camera.title: The camera
camera.about: Texts of the camera that reads QR codes: on the teacher page, on the Tasks page and on a phone.

teacher-tasks.title: Prepared tasks
teacher-tasks.about: The Prepared tasks tab: the list of tasks made and one open task with its QR code.

placement.title: Keyboard check
placement.about: The calm placement check that finds the keys the player already types with all fingers without looking.

end-placement.title: Keyboard check end
end-placement.about: The end card of the keyboard check: the keys the player can use, the strong and weak keys of the run and its buttons.

rhythm.title: Rhythm
rhythm.about: The beat game next to the parrot: letters fall to the beat of generated music and the child catches them in a basket; it trains even typing (rhythm), after accuracy and before speed. A great round earns a rhythm note, shown under My progress.

end-rhythm.title: Rhythm end card
end-rhythm.about: The rows and news of the end card after a Rytmus round: accuracy, rhythm, tempo, letters caught.

situations.map.storyFairy: Heading of the third story on the map. Its longer words (4 letters or more) are secret words too: typed on the My progress page they start the badge show.
situations.surprise.waitingTitle: Map: heading of the window that lists the surprises still waiting (opened from the closed box beside the character).
situations.surprise.toldTitle: Map: heading of the surprises window when a surprise was won today (the won ones come first with their answers, then the waiting ones).
situations.surprise.toldTip: Map: tooltip of the open golden box beside the character on a day a surprise was won.
situations.surprise.waitingTip: Map: tooltip of the closed golden box beside the character while surprises wait.
situations.surprise.need.minutesOne: Map, waiting surprises: what a surprise after training time still needs; {n} (1) minutes in all, {have} trained so far.
situations.surprise.need.minutesMany: The same for {n} of 5 and more.
situations.surprise.need.levelsOne: Map, waiting surprises: a surprise after more levels; {n} (1) levels in all, {have} done so far.
situations.surprise.need.levelsMany: The same for {n} of 5 and more.
situations.surprise.need.starsOne: Map, waiting surprises: a surprise after more stars; {n} (1) stars in all, {have} won so far.
situations.surprise.need.starsMany: The same for {n} of 5 and more.
situations.surprise.need.level: Map, waiting surprises: a surprise after a level; {level} is the level's name, {left} how many levels are still to finish up to it.
situations.surprise.ask: Bold start of the question of a secret a parent prepared; shown on a level card.
situations.surprise.left.minutes: What is still needed. {n} is the number of minutes of training.
situations.surprise.left.levelsOne: A parent's surprise: what is still needed when 1 level is left. {n} is the count.
situations.surprise.left.levelsFew: A parent's surprise: what is still needed when 2 to 4 levels are left. {n} is the count.
situations.surprise.left.levelsMany: A parent's surprise: what is still needed when 5 or more levels are left. {n} is the count.
situations.surprise.left.starsOne: What is still needed, when 1 star is left. {n} is the count.
situations.surprise.left.starsFew: A parent's surprise: what is still needed when 2 to 4 stars are left. {n} is the count.
situations.surprise.left.starsMany: A parent's surprise: what is still needed when 5 or more stars are left. {n} is the count.
situations.tracks.menu: Name of the menu music, in the "Music: ..." notice when the song changes.
situations.tracks.relaxing: Name of the relaxing music in the same notice.
situations.tracks.break: Name of the break music in the same notice.
situations.level.ownText: Level title when the child types a parent's own text.
situations.level.freeType: Title in the top bar of the free typing screen.
situations.level.read: Tooltip of the button (F3) in a level that reads the words aloud.
situations.level.titleWords: A level's name on the map and in the wardrobe; {name} is the world's name, {level} the level number.
situations.level.place: Tooltip of the level-number ring in the top bar; {n} is this level, {total} the number of levels in the world.
situations.level.help: Tooltip of the question-mark button (F1) in a level that opens help.
situations.level.helpNow: Heading in the help page for what the current level asks, shown when help is opened from a level.
situations.level.practice: Title of the own typing screen.
situations.level.guide: Tooltip of the button (F2) that shows or hides the on-screen keyboard.
situations.level.pause: Tooltip of the pause button in the level's top bar.
situations.level.paused: Heading of the small card shown when the level is paused.
situations.level.pauseClose: Name of the X on the pause card; goes on playing, like Esc.
situations.level.slower: Button on the pause card that lowers the difficulty so the game goes slower.
situations.level.stretch: Button on the pause card, and the title of the short stretch with a countdown.
situations.level.stretchLong: Button on the short stretch that opens the map's warm-up (several exercises); going on typing from it continues the level, cancelling returns to the pause card.
situations.level.stretchDone: Button that ends the short stretch and brings the pause card back.
situations.level.slowerSaid: The character, right after the child presses Slower on the pause card.
situations.level.leave: Tooltip of the X button in free typing that leaves the game.
situations.level.progress: Tooltip of the progress bar in the level's top bar.
situations.level.speed: Label of the speed gauge in a level; {n} is the number of letters per minute.
situations.level.keyAccuracy: Tooltip of a key's accuracy button in practice; {key} is the key, {n} the percent typed right.
situations.level.layoutHint: The character, when the game notices a different keyboard than the chosen one, pointing to the layout switch at the bottom right under the keyboard; {layout} is the layout's name.
situations.level.shiftOtherHand: The character or the new key card, when the child pressed Shift with the same hand as the letter.
situations.level.memoryWait: The character, when the child types while the word is still showing in remember-it typing.
situations.level.stickyWait: Line over the scene in a sticky finger run while the held key is up, also at the start of each round; {keys} is the key's cap, for example J.
situations.level.stickyWaitMany: The same line when several keys are held; {keys} are their caps, for example A S D.
situations.level.stickyCheckTitle: Heading of the short keyboard check before the first sticky finger run on a device that holds several keys at once.
situations.level.stickyCheck: What the keyboard check asks; {keys} are the three keys to hold (A S D), {key} the one to press (F).
situations.level.stickyCheckFewer: The keyboard check when the keyboard reported fewer keys at once than asked; it must never blame the child.
situations.level.noVoice: Notice at the start of dictation when the browser cannot read aloud, so the words are shown.
situations.level.noVoiceMemory: Notice in the note game when the browser cannot read aloud, so each note glows first.
situations.level.end: The Stop typing button: on the pause card, in the confirm question, the round X of an exercise and on every end card (back to the map).
situations.level.keepPractice: Button on the pause card and in the confirm question that continues an exercise.
situations.level.keepLevel: Button on the pause card and in the confirm question that continues a story level (Continue).
situations.level.keepTyping: Button on the pause card in free typing that keeps typing.
situations.level.endAsk: Heading of the question asked when leaving a level after at least one key was pressed.
situations.level.endLevelText: Text of the question when ending a story level.
situations.level.endPracticeText: Text of the question when ending an exercise.
situations.level.stayStart: The character, at the start of a stay-and-type session without a limit.
situations.keys.*: Name of a special key, used inside sentences and tooltips about keys.
situations.layouts.*: Name of a keyboard layout, in the parent settings, the layout switch's menu and the different-keyboard notice.
situations.layoutsShort.*: Short name of a keyboard layout on the quiet switch under the on-screen keyboard.
situations.fingers.*: A finger's name used inside a sentence, for example in the character's hint or on the new key card.
situations.guide.deadStep1: Hint above the on-screen keyboard for an accented letter; {ch} is the letter, the accent key comes first.
situations.guide.deadStep2: Hint above the on-screen keyboard after the accent key; {ch} is the letter to type now.
situations.posture.title: Heading of the get-ready card shown before a level.
situations.posture.back: One of the sitting tips on the card before a level; one is picked at random.
situations.posture.feet: One of the sitting tips on the card before a level; one is picked at random.
situations.posture.wrists: One of the sitting tips on the card before a level; one is picked at random.
situations.posture.eyes: One of the sitting tips on the card before a level; one is picked at random.
situations.posture.space: The line under the picture on the card before a level, shown about four seconds after it opened when the space bar has not been pressed (the hands have come onto the keys by then). {link} is the link of posture.spaceLink.
situations.posture.spaceLink: The link inside posture.space (the home position), which opens the home position card again.
situations.posture.spaceKey: Text on the drawn space bar on the card before a level.
situations.posture.close: Tooltip of the close button on the card before a level; closes it and starts play.
situations.keysIntro.title: Heading of the card told once before the very first new key card.
situations.keysIntro.close: Label of that card's close cross.
situations.keysIntro.text: Paragraphs of that card in order: why new keys come, how a new key card closes (the key typed right three times, or Esc), and that this card closes with the space bar. **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.controlKey.escape.title: Heading of the card told once before the first new key card: the Esc key, which never counts among the learned keys.
situations.controlKey.escape.close: Label of that card's close cross.
situations.controlKey.escape.text: Paragraphs of that card: some keys do not count but matter, Esc is the first; Esc pauses the game, another Esc goes on, Esc closes every card. **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.controlKey.escape.type: Line asking to press Esc three times; the third press closes the card.
situations.controlKey.tab.title: Heading of the card told once in the level after the one where Enter first came: the Tab key, which never counts among the learned keys.
situations.controlKey.tab.close: Label of that card's close cross (Esc skips it).
situations.controlKey.tab.text: Paragraphs of that card: where Tab is; Tab moves between buttons and links on a page, Enter opens them, Shift + Tab goes back, so pages work without a mouse. **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.controlKey.tab.type: Line asking to press Tab three times.
situations.controlKey.backspace.title: Heading of the card told once before the first crossroads level: the Backspace key, which never counts among the learned keys.
situations.controlKey.backspace.close: Label of that card's close cross (Esc skips it).
situations.controlKey.backspace.text: Paragraphs of that card: where Backspace is; in this game it wipes the whole started choice to change one's mind, not to fix letters; elsewhere it deletes a letter and Ctrl + Backspace a word, but typing without mistakes matters more, since a fix costs at least three presses. **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.controlKey.backspace.type: Line asking to press Backspace three times.
situations.newKey.title: Heading of the new key card, next to the big key.
situations.homeRow.title: Title of the home position card, which comes right before the first of the new keys F and J and opens again from the link on the card before a level.
situations.homeRow.before: Paragraphs of the home position card above its row of home keys: the keys with bumps, finding them by touch with closed eyes, the other fingers and the thumbs. {f} and {j} are the keys with bumps, {left} and {right} the other home keys of each hand, spaced (A S D, K L ;). **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.homeRow.after: Paragraphs of the home position card under its row of home keys: fingers come back after each key, sitting straight, only accuracy counts, never looking at the keyboard. **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.homeRow.close: Label of the home position card's close button.
situations.newKey.skip: Tooltip of the close button on the new key card; skips the practice.
situations.newKey.finger: New key card: which finger presses the key; {finger} is the finger's name.
situations.newKey.fingerBack: New key card: the finger and going back; {finger} is the finger's name, {home} the home key.
situations.newKey.typeIt: New key card: asks to type the key three times; {key} is the key.
situations.newKey.shiftL: Card for the left Shift: how to hold it; {sample} is the letter typed as a capital.
situations.newKey.shiftR: Card for the right Shift: how to hold it; {sample} is the letter typed as a capital.
situations.newKey.space: Card for the space bar: how to press it.
situations.newKey.spaceThumb: Card for the space bar: which thumb presses it, and to try both thumbs in turn.
situations.practice.parts: Counter in own-text practice; {n} is the part reached, {total} the number of parts.
situations.practice.left: Counter in timed practice; {s} is the number of seconds left.
situations.practice.words: Counter in untimed practice; {n} is the number of words typed.
situations.practice.backTip: Tooltip of the round X button in untimed practice.
situations.practiceKeys.title: Heading of the window for choosing keys before own typing.
situations.practiceKeys.about: First paragraph of the key-choosing window: what own typing is, apart from the worlds.
situations.practiceKeys.intro: Explanation under the heading of the key-choosing window.
situations.practiceKeys.slider: Label and tooltip of the slider that adds keys in lesson order.
situations.practiceKeys.step: Counter next to the slider; {n} is the step, {total} the number of steps.
situations.practiceKeys.own: Label next to the slider when the keys were chosen by hand.
situations.practiceKeys.countOne: Number of chosen keys when exactly one; {n} is the count.
situations.practiceKeys.countFew: Number of chosen keys for two to four keys; {n} is the count.
situations.practiceKeys.countMany: Number of chosen keys for five or more, or none; {n} is the count.
situations.practiceKeys.needLetters: Notice in the key-choosing window until enough letters are chosen; {n} is the minimum.
situations.practiceKeys.style: Label of the group of typing-style buttons in the key-choosing window.
situations.practiceKeys.copy: Typing style button: the child sees the word and copies it.
situations.practiceKeys.dictation: Typing style button: the child hears the word and types it.
situations.practiceKeys.memory: Typing style button: the word shows briefly and the child types it from memory.
situations.practiceKeys.copyTip: Tooltip of the Copy button, and the line under the buttons when it is selected.
situations.practiceKeys.dictationTip: Tooltip of the Dictation button, and the line under the buttons when it is selected.
situations.practiceKeys.memoryTip: Tooltip of the Remember it button, and the line under the buttons when it is selected.
situations.practiceKeys.sticky: Button of the sticky finger way of typing: one finger holds its home key while the other fingers type.
situations.practiceKeys.stickyTip: Tooltip of the Sticky finger button, and the line under the buttons when it is selected.
situations.practiceKeys.stickyNeeds: Tooltip of the Sticky finger button while too few keys of a hand are chosen; {n} is the minimum per hand.
situations.practiceKeys.start: Button in the key-choosing window that starts the exercise.
situations.freeType.start: The character, at the start of free typing.
situations.freeType.hint: Quiet hint on the free typing screen while nothing is typed.
situations.freeType.place: Tooltip of the free typing button that opens the place picker.
situations.freeType.pick: Heading of the place picker window in free typing.
situations.touch.title: Heading of the notice shown when the child taps the touch screen in a level without having used a keyboard.
situations.touch.text: Text of the notice shown when the child taps the touch screen and has not used a keyboard yet.
situations.paw.title: Tooltip of the paw button in a level; {n} is the words without a mistake needed to charge, {words} the words the paw types.
situations.paw.aria: Screen-reader label of the paw button; {n} is the number of charged paws.
situations.paw.start: The character, when the paw starts typing for the child.
situations.paw.charged: The character, when a paw gets charged; {n} is the words without a mistake, {words} the words the paw will type.
situations.tapko.statsHint: Tooltip of the character on the map and in a level; clicking opens the statistics.
situations.tapko.correct_streak: The character during play after a run of right words; one line is picked at random. {name} is the player's nickname.
situations.tapko.mistake: The character during play after two mistakes in a row; one line is picked at random.
situations.tapko.hint: The character during play when the child struggles with a key; one line is picked at random. {key} is the key, {finger} the finger to press it.
situations.tapko.break: The character, when it is time for a break, in play and on the results screen; one line is picked at random.
situations.fairy.start: Fairy Melody at the start of a level in the fairy story; one line is picked at random.
situations.fairy.mistake: Fairy Melody after two mistakes in a row in the fairy story; one line is picked at random.
situations.fairy.done: Fairy Melody after finishing a level in the fairy story; one line is picked at random.
situations.story.next: The Next button in a story scene; on the last line it becomes Continue.
situations.story.world.meadow: Story of the meadow (world 1), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.space: Story of space (world 2), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.planet: Story of the dragons' planet (world 3), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.dragons: Story of Dragon Valley (world 4), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.egg: Story of the egg mountain world (world 5), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.junkyard: Story of the junkyard (world 6), the start of the robot story with Bolt, on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.workshop: Story of the workshop (world 7), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.raintown: Story of the rain in town (world 8), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.robocity: Story of Robot City (world 9), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.robohome: Story of Bolt's home (world 10), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.garden: Story of the garden (world 11), the start of the fairy story; Melody speaks too, on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.forestpath: Story of the forest path (world 12), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.lilylake: Story of the lake (world 13), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.musictree: Story of the Music Tree (world 14), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.world.moonball: Story of the moonlit ball (world 15), on the get-ready card before its first level the first time; **phrase** is shown in bold.
situations.story.scenes.invitation: Scene after finishing the meadow (world 1), a reward from the results screen.
situations.story.scenes.landing: Scene after finishing space (world 2), a reward from the results screen.
situations.story.scenes.force: Scene after finishing the new planet (world 3), a reward from the results screen.
situations.story.scenes.egg: Scene after finishing Dragon Valley (world 4): the dragons flew off, the fire burned out and an egg is left behind; a reward from the results screen.
situations.story.scenes.hatched: Scene after finishing the egg mountain (world 5): the dragons' hearth blazes and the dragon hatches; a reward from the results screen.
situations.story.scenes.friends: Scene after finishing the junkyard (world 6), when the child meets the robot Bolt.
situations.story.scenes.legs: Scene after finishing the workshop (world 7), when Bolt gets new legs.
situations.story.scenes.raincoat: Scene after finishing the rain (world 8), when Bolt gets a raincoat.
situations.story.scenes.key: Scene after finishing Robot City (world 9), when the big gate opens.
situations.story.scenes.home: Scene after finishing Bolt's home (world 10), the end of the robot story. {name} is the player's nickname.
situations.story.scenes.wreath: Scene after finishing the garden (world 11), when the fairy weaves a wreath.
situations.story.scenes.feather: Scene after finishing the forest path (world 12), when the owl gives a feather.
situations.story.scenes.lily: Scene after finishing the lake (world 13), when the child gets a water lily.
situations.story.scenes.harp: Scene after finishing the Music Tree (world 14), when the child gets a harp.
situations.story.scenes.wings: Scene after finishing the moonlit ball (world 15), the end of the fairy story. {name} is the player's nickname.
situations.story.meadowStart: Opening line of a meadow level, shown when play begins.
situations.story.commandStart: Opening line of rocket level 4: the astronaut writes commands, each one sent brings the rocket closer.
situations.story.commandReply: The rocket's short answers in its speech bubble after an accepted command; one is picked at random.
situations.story.commandRejected: The rocket's short answers in its speech bubble after a rejected command (a row with slips); one is picked at random.
situations.story.asteroidStart: Opening line of the rocket world's big challenge: big asteroids break into smaller rocks, two rocks have a shield and their word is typed twice.
situations.story.boarded: Shout over the rocket when the astronaut has jumped into it at the end of rocket level 4.
situations.story.strongStart: Opening line of rocket level 3: explains the glowing strong meteors whose word is typed twice.
situations.story.strongHit: Short shouts over a strong meteor when its word is typed the first time; one is picked at random.
situations.story.hopStart: Opening line of the calm rocket level: the astronaut hops from meteor to meteor (short words) to reach the rocket.
situations.story.hopTooFar: The astronaut's line in the calm rocket level when the typed word is on a meteor he would reach only by jumping over more than one; the word stays on that meteor.
situations.story.poppyStart: Opening lines of the calm meadow level (one is picked): poppy buds grow with a short word above them, a typed word makes the bud bloom and adds a poppy to the bouquet shown at the end.
situations.story.poppyDone: Praise at the end of the calm meadow level, when the typed poppies gather into a bouquet (one is picked).
situations.story.gustStart: The character's line when the wind blows in the third meadow level and more small leaves come at once.
situations.story.invitationStart: Opening line of the meadow level where the child writes a party invitation word by word with no slip.
situations.story.invitationPartyOne: End of the invitation level, over the guests: {n} (1) words typed right invited that many animals; the line break splits it into two lines.
situations.story.invitationPartyMany: The same for {n} of 5 and more, or 0.
situations.story.goalShout: Shout above the meadow when a leaf is not typed in time and a goal is scored.
situations.story.cheer: A happy shout above the character at a success in play (meadow, forest, lake, gate); one is picked at random.
situations.story.hedgehogStart: Opening line of the hedgehog level on the meadow, shown when play begins.
situations.story.hedgehogDone: Line on the meadow when the child has caught all of the hedgehog's leaves.
situations.story.swampStart: Opening line of the planet's first level: the character landed in a swamp and jumps on stones that appear when a word is typed.
situations.story.swampDone: The character when he reaches the bank of the swamp and sees the meadow; one is picked at random.
situations.story.crystalsStart: Opening line of the planet's second level: crystals grow on the meadow; type the word above one before it cracks.
situations.story.crystalsDoneOne: Text in the middle at the end of the crystal level when the character collected one crystal; {n} is the number.
situations.story.crystalsDoneFew: Text in the middle at the end of the crystal level for a few crystals (2 to 4 in Slovak); {n} is the number.
situations.story.crystalsDoneMany: Text in the middle at the end of the crystal level for many crystals (also 0); {n} is the number.
situations.story.crossroadsStart: Opening line of the crossroads level: words on the road and signposts with paths at a crossroads.
situations.story.roadEnd: The character at the end of the road in the crossroads level; one is picked at random.
situations.story.signGone: Line when the child first slips in a sign's word and the sign vanishes.
situations.story.signLast: Line when the child slips in the last sign's word: the word starts again.
situations.story.path.*.names: Names of the path on the signpost above its word; one is picked at random. Short, two words at most.
situations.story.path.*.said: The character when the child takes this path; says what the path changes. One is picked at random.
situations.story.path.unknown.*: A part of the line about the unknown road ({len}, {time} or {diff} in story.path.unknownSaid).
situations.story.path.unknownSaid: The character after taking the unknown road says what happened: {len} word length, {time} road length, {diff} word difficulty.
situations.story.spellStart: Opening line of the spell level: three sleeping crystals of life; a spell breaks with three slips and a new one comes.
situations.story.spellCast: A short shout over the crystals when a spell works and the next third lights up; one is picked at random.
situations.story.spellBroken: Line when a spell breaks (more than three slips) and a new one comes; one is picked at random.
situations.story.greatSwampStart: Opening line of the planet's last level: from a firm stone the child jumps four stones; a slip cracks them.
situations.story.greatSwampSlip: Line when the child first slips away from the firm stone and the stones start to crack.
situations.story.swampLog: The character's line when a small floating log lies where the next stone should be in the swamp (planet levels 1 and 5); each typed word pushes it a bit until it floats away.
situations.story.monolithAsk: The character on the shore of the great swamp: a longer sentence typed without a slip wakes the monolith; one is picked at random.
situations.story.monolithSlip: The character when a slip spoils that sentence and a new one comes; one is picked at random.
situations.story.cradleDone: Line at the end of the Planet world when the character puts the crystals of life on the monolith; one is picked at random.
situations.story.flamesStart: Opening line of the valley's first level: little flames fly to the character, a typed one is caught in his torch and lights the fire pit.
situations.story.flamesDone: Line at the end of the flames level: the fire pit burns and the dragons will see it; one is picked at random.
situations.story.thicketStart: Opening line of the overgrown path: each bush has a spell (a word) typed without a slip; a slip grows two more branches.
situations.story.thicketSlip: Short line when a spell on a bush has a slip (the first time, then now and then); playful, one is picked at random.
situations.story.thicketDone: Line at the end of the overgrown path: it is open and the baby dragons peek out; one is picked at random.
situations.story.flightStart: Opening line of the flying lessons: typing in a steady rhythm keeps a baby dragon flying over the bushes to the fire.
situations.story.flightBush: What a baby dragon shouts when it lands in the bushes instead of flying over them (a giggle, never sad); one is picked at random.
situations.story.flightHard: What a baby dragon says when it stopped flying past the bushes and landed hard (a little bump, never hurt); one is picked at random.
situations.story.flightOops: What a baby dragon cries out at the second slip during its flight, wobbling but flying on (short, startled, never hurt); one is picked at random.
situations.story.flightDone: Text in the middle at the end of the flying lessons; {n} is how many baby dragons flew, {m} how many tried. The plural form follows {n}. Keep the line break.
situations.story.lullabyStart: Opening line of the lullaby: the baby dragons circle and cannot sleep; the child copies the lullaby line by line, each line ends with a period.
situations.story.lullabyDone: Line at the end of the lullaby: all the baby dragons sleep by the fire; one is picked at random.
situations.story.takeoffStart: Opening line of the valley's super-obstacle: in the morning the baby dragons fly off to the crystal meadow; each needs a few groups of words without a slip and in time.
situations.story.takeoffBack: Gentle line when a baby dragon glides back to the fire to try again (a late word or a slip); one is picked at random.
situations.story.takeoffGone: Line when a baby dragon flies off to the crystal meadow; one is picked at random.
situations.story.takeoffBye: What the character calls after the baby dragons when the last one has flown off; one is picked at random.
situations.story.eggHello: What the egg says to the character when it appears in the fire pit after the dragons have flown off (short, curious, friendly); one is picked at random.
situations.story.windStart: Opening line of the wind level on the mountain (world 5, level 1): words come in gusts of wind; typed before the gust reaches the character, he walks on up the path.
situations.story.windGust: What the character says when a gust of wind reaches him and pushes him a few steps back (short, playful); one is picked at random.
situations.story.windLonger: The narrator, the first time a strengthened gust (after two slips in its word) pushes the character back: the way got longer (two more words).
situations.story.windDone: Line at the end of the wind level: the character reached a sheltered ledge where the wind drops; one is picked at random.
situations.story.mudStart: Opening line of the sticky puddles level: each round has words over places on the path, pick one over a clean place; a word over a puddle gets the character stuck.
situations.story.mudStep: What the character says when he steps into a sticky puddle (short, never sad); one is picked at random.
situations.story.mudSlow: The character's bubble (top left) after a mud step: the mud slows him, the next three words are hard. One line.
situations.story.mudFree: What the character says when he gets out of the mud after the three hard words; one is picked at random.
situations.story.mudDone: Line at the end of the sticky puddles level: the puddles are behind, the character wipes his paws and walks on; one is picked at random.
situations.story.mountainStart: Opening line of the crossroads level on the mountain (world 5, level 3): pick a signpost and type its word.
situations.story.mountainEnd: The character at the end of the mountain crossroads: he can see the summit; one is picked at random.
situations.story.roadClosed: The character when the countdown of the best path on the mountain runs out and its signpost vanishes; one is picked at random.
situations.story.roadCareful: The character's short call on the mountain crossroads level when the child slips twice in one road word and gets a slightly easier one; one is picked at random.
situations.story.bouldersStart: Opening text of the boulders level: small stones fall from the rocks and roll down the path at the character; a typed word over a stone makes it fall off the path before it reaches him.
situations.story.boulderOops: What the character says when a stone rolls into him and bounces off (short, funny, never hurt); one is picked at random.
situations.story.bouldersLonger: The narrator, the first time a boulder is missed: the way to the summit got a little longer.
situations.story.bouldersDone: Line at the end of the boulders level: the summit is in sight, said to the egg; one is picked at random.
situations.story.awakeningStart: Opening line of the super level of the egg mountain: lay the egg into the dragons' hearth and type one long spell from a ribbon; a slip adds a new word to the spell; when it is said, the hearth wakes up and so does the little dragon.
situations.story.spellSlip: The narrator, the first time the spell has a slip: the word starts again and one new word was added to the spell.
situations.story.spellCareful: A rare reminder after later slips in the spell: it must be exact.
situations.story.spellHello: What the little dragon says when it hatches and hops out of the hearth to the character at the end of the spell: just a short hello.
situations.story.copyLoopStart: Line on the get-ready card of every level of a world not built yet: the level is still being made, for now the child copies the words in the middle until the time is up.
situations.story.copyLoopSoon: Small words on the sign at the top of such a level, under the world's name: the world is still being made.
situations.story.copyLoopCount: Small counter under the panel of such a level; {n} is the number of words typed.
situations.story.copyLoopDone: Text in the middle at the end of such a level; {n} is the number of words typed. Keep the line break.
situations.story.matchStart: Opening line of the meadow's third level: the real football match begins.
situations.story.spaceStart: Opening line of the rocket's first level: the flight to the first planet.
situations.aim.title: Name of the game: the button and tooltip on the map, and the level title at the top while playing.
situations.aim.start: Story on the card before the range: what the range is for and the rare thing of each range.
situations.aim.swapHint: Added to the rules at the start once the child has found a rare thing.
situations.aim.swap: The character, when the child presses Enter to swap for a rare thing. {name} is the thing's name.
situations.aim.ready: Bubble when a trained letter is now accurate and leaves the list. {keys} are the letters.
situations.aim.score: The score in the top right corner during the range. {hits} is the target hits, {points} the points so far.
situations.aim.record: The character, when the run's points beat the range's record for the first time.
situations.aim.stayTip: Tooltip of the Stay at the range button on the end card.
situations.aim.stayStart: The character, when the range continues after the end card.
situations.aim.collection.new: The character, when the child hits a rare thing in the middle for the first time.
situations.aim.collection.waiting: Tooltip of a grey thing in the collection. {world} is the world where it waits.
situations.aim.lines.center: The target, when a thing hits the dead centre. One line is picked at random; {n} is the points (100).
situations.aim.lines.one: The target, when a thing hits just off the centre. {n} is the points.
situations.aim.lines.two: The target, when a thing hits further from the centre. {n} is the points.
situations.aim.lines.miss: The target, when the word was too slow and the thing flies past behind it. One line at random.
situations.aim.lines.fall: The target, when a thing falls short and drops. One line is picked at random.
situations.aim.lines.pop: A sound that sometimes pops out of the target after a hit (the thing's own sound comes first). One word at random.
situations.aim.lines.expectWorry: The target, worried about a thing flying at it. One line is picked at random.
situations.aim.lines.expectWonder: The target, wondering about a thing flying at it. One line is picked at random.
situations.aim.lines.expectCheer: The target, looking forward to a thing flying at it. One line is picked at random.
situations.aim.lines.streak3: After the third bullseye in a row. One line is picked at random.
situations.aim.lines.streak5: After the fifth bullseye in a row. One line is picked at random.
situations.aim.lines.shrink: The target, when it shrinks because the child now types accurately. One line at random.
situations.aim.lines.last: The target, when the last throw is about to come. One line is picked at random.
situations.aim.things.*.name: Name of the thing in the collection (tooltip) and in the swap line. Also used as {item} in the other texts.
situations.aim.things.*.launch: The character, when he throws the {item}. One line is picked at random.
situations.aim.things.*.sound: A sound that pops out of the target after the {item} hits. One word at random.
situations.aim.things.*.hit: The target, when the {item} hits the dead centre. One line is picked at random.
situations.aim.things.*.expect: The target, when the {item} is flying at it. One line is picked at random.
situations.aim.things.egg.hatch: The target, when the egg hits the centre and a chick hatches. One line at random.
situations.aim.things.egg.hatchSound: The cracking sound when the egg hatches. One word at random.
situations.aim.things.egg.hatchedCall: The character, when the egg hatches in flight at ring 2. One line at random.
situations.aim.things.egg.hatchFlight: The target, when the chick that hatched in flight arrives. One line at random.
situations.aim.things.boomerang.caught: The character, when he catches the returning boomerang. One line at random.
situations.aim.things.snowflake.melt: The target, when the snowflake melts into a water drop in flight at ring 2. One line at random.
situations.aim.things.snowflake.dropSound: A sound that pops out of the target after the melted snowflake (a water drop) hits. One word at random.
situations.aim.things.snowflake.dropHit: The target, when the melted snowflake (a water drop) hits the dead centre. One line at random.
situations.parrot.title: Name of the game: the node on the map and the level title at the top while playing.
situations.parrot.start: The character explains the game on the card before it starts and in a bubble at the start.
situations.parrot.phase2: The character in a bubble when the second half of the parrot round starts: try to type a word faster than in the first half.
situations.parrot.slip: At the third mistake the parrot takes off, flies a while, says one of these lines and comes back. It drags its sounds (r, vowels) like a parrot; the translation may too.
situations.parrot.leave: With too many mistakes the parrot says one of these lines and flies away; the round ends. Drawn-out sounds like a parrot.
situations.parrot.won: When the round is learned, the parrot praises the child with one of these. Drawn-out sounds like a parrot.
situations.parrot.coming: Right after the praise the parrot says one of these, then flies to the child and out of the scene. Drawn-out sounds like a parrot.
situations.parrot.again: Button on the end card: a new round with new words.
situations.parrot.badge: Tooltip and label of Aro, the Parrot badge parrot on his perch (map, My progress), and of the small badge mark on the end card.
situations.parrot.name: The badge parrot's name, Aro. A name: keep it or give it a short, easy name in the language.
situations.parrot.takeoff: Aro says one of these when the child clicks him on the map, then flies a round over the page and lands again. Drawn-out sounds like a parrot.
situations.parrot.goodbye: Aro says one of these when the Parrot badge is lost, then flies away from the map. Drawn-out sounds like a parrot.
situations.parrot.arrive: Aro says one of these when he lands on his perch on the map the first time after the Parrot badge is won. Some use his name. Drawn-out sounds like a parrot.
situations.end.level: Title of the end card after a story level.
situations.end.practice: Title of the end card after a practice (own keys, own text, a task's practice).
situations.end.stay: Title of the end card after staying a while in a level (an easy round with no end).
situations.end.range: Title of the end card after the target range.
situations.end.rangeRecord: Title of the end card after the target range when the run beat the range's record.
situations.end.journey: Title of the end card after the whole hero's journey.
situations.end.parrotHome: Title of the end card when the parrot stayed: it is at home now.
situations.end.parrotLost: Title of the end card when the parrot flew off after too many mistakes. No exclamation: a calm line.
situations.end.freeType: Title of the end card when the child leaves free typing after typing something.
situations.end.break: Title of the end card after the stretch break.
situations.end.taskDone: Title of the card with the result link of a finished task.
situations.end.toMap: Last button of every end card: back to the map.
situations.end.breakBtn: Main button of an end card when a break is due: the stretch break.
situations.end.surpriseNew: Band on an end card when this run unlocked a parent's surprise.
situations.end.surpriseSee: Main button of an end card with a surprise: opens the surprises won today.
situations.end.accuracy: Row label on an end card; the value is the accuracy in percent.
situations.end.speed: Row label on an end card: the typing speed; the value is the letters per minute (end.letters).
situations.end.dictationClean: Row label on an end card after a dictation; the value is end.ofTotal.
situations.end.memoryClean: Row label on an end card after typing from memory; the value is end.ofTotal.
situations.end.mixedClean: Row label on an end card after a mixed dictation and memory run; the value is end.ofTotal.
situations.end.ofTotal: A row value: {n} of {total} (targets, rare things).
situations.end.task: Row label on an end card: the teacher's task (its title, or whether this run is the best).
situations.end.taskBest: Row value on the end card of a teacher's task: this run became the task's best (the one handed in).
situations.end.taskKept: Row value on the end card of a teacher's task: an earlier run was better and stays the one handed in.
situations.end.points: Row label on the range's end card; the value is the points of the run.
situations.end.centers: Row label on the range's end card; the value is the hits in the middle of the target.
situations.end.newFind: Green line on the range's end card, beside the picture of a rare thing this run added to the collection.
situations.end.parrotWords: Row label on the parrot's end card; the value is the first three words.
situations.end.speedStart: Row label on the parrot's end card: speed in the first half of the round; the value is end.letters.
situations.end.speedRepeat: Row label on the parrot's end card: speed in the second half of the round; the value is end.letters.
situations.end.parrotBeaten: Row label on the parrot's end card: the words typed faster in the second half than at their best in the first; the value lists them.
situations.end.tryAgain: Under the empty perch when the parrot flew off. Short, lower case.
situations.end.parrotTip: Yellow tip on the end card when the parrot flew off.
situations.end.time: Row label: how long the free typing or the break took; the value is end.minutes.
situations.end.lastText: Row label on the free typing end card; the value is the last text the child typed.
situations.end.underMinute: End card time when the child typed less than a minute (instead of a count of minutes).
situations.end.sendTeacher: Row label on the finished task's card; the value is end.sendHow.
situations.end.sendHow: Row value: what to send to the teacher.
situations.end.letterBetter: Green line on the range's end card: the trained letter that got most accurate. {key} is the letter, {before} and {after} percent.
situations.end.faster: Green line on the parrot's end card when repeating was faster than the usual speed of the last 14 days.
situations.end.keyMastered: Green line on the end card of a short practice of a few keys: one of them is mastered now. {key} is the key.
situations.end.drillKeys: Row label on the end card of a short practice of more than three keys: their accuracy together, before and after.
situations.end.drillUp: Read aloud for the small green up arrow beside a key's accuracy on the short practice's end card.
situations.end.onceMore: Main button on the end card of a short practice: the same keys again.
situations.end.letters: A speed value: {n} letters (per minute; the row label says per minute).
situations.end.minutes: A time value under the picture or in a row: {n} minutes.
situations.end.hits: Under the range's picture: all target hits of the run.
situations.end.words: Under the parrot's or free typing's picture: the words learned or typed.
situations.end.exercises: Under the break's picture: the exercises done.
situations.end.moreRewards: Added after the first reward in the green line when more came at once: "Gold badge and 2 more rewards".
situations.results.peek: Name of the X on a results card; hides the card to look at the game under it, like Esc. Any key brings the card back.
situations.results.starsAria: Hidden label of the stars (read by screen readers). {n} is the number earned, {max} the most a level gives.
situations.results.byTapko: Fact shown instead of accuracy when mostly the paw played the level.
situations.results.trendUp: Fact on the results card when the typing speed grew since last week.
situations.results.newKey: Fact on the results card when one new key opened. {key} is the key.
situations.results.newKeys: Fact on the results card when several new keys opened. {keys} are the keys.
situations.results.newAccessory: Fact on the results card. {n} is the number of new things in the wardrobe.
situations.results.newCompanion: Fact on the results card. {kind} is the kind of the new character.
situations.results.next: Button on the results card: the next level.
situations.results.replay: Button on the results card: play the level again.
situations.results.stay: Button on the results card: keep playing the level a while.
situations.results.reward: Button on the results card after a world is done: the reward story.
situations.results.growthTitle: Heading of the new medal fact on the results card.
situations.results.medalAria: Hidden label of a medal (read by screen readers). {n} is the medal number.
situations.results.badgeNew: Fact on the results card for the first badge of a world.
situations.results.badgeSilver: Fact on the results card when a world badge turns silver.
situations.results.badgeGold: Fact on the results card when a world badge turns gold.
situations.badge.bronze: Name of the badge tier, inserted into the badge label.
situations.badge.silver: Name of the badge tier, inserted into the badge label.
situations.badge.gold: Name of the badge tier, inserted into the badge label.
situations.badge.aria: Hidden label of a badge (read by screen readers). {world} is the world, {tier} the badge tier.
situations.badge.locked: Hidden label of a badge not earned yet. {n} is the world number.
situations.badge.tip.bronze: Tooltip of a bronze badge. {world} is the world, {bronze} the stars needed for bronze.
situations.badge.tip.silver: Tooltip of a silver badge. {world} is the world, {silver} the stars needed for silver.
situations.badge.tip.gold: Tooltip of a gold badge. {world} is the world, {gold} the stars needed for gold.
situations.badge.tip.toSilver: Added to the tooltip of a bronze badge. {silver} is the goal, {have} the stars so far.
situations.badge.tip.toGold: Added to the tooltip of a silver badge. {gold} is the goal, {have} the stars so far.
situations.badge.tip.locked: Tooltip of a badge not earned yet. {world} is the world, {bronze} the stars needed for bronze, {have} the stars so far.
situations.progress.title: Heading of the progress screen, and the label of the character on the map that opens it.
situations.progress.keys: Tooltip of the keys counter in the progress. {n} of {total}.
situations.progress.worlds: Tooltip of the worlds counter in the progress. {n} of {total}.
situations.progress.chest: Tooltip of the chest in the progress. {n} points of {total}.
situations.progress.stories: Tooltip of the stories counter in the progress. {n} of {total}.
situations.progress.stars: Tooltip of the stars counter in the progress. {n} of {total}.
situations.progress.showCode: Button that shows the QR code of all progress.
situations.progress.overallTitle: Title of the result stored in the QR code of all progress.
situations.progress.overallCaption: Caption under the big QR code of all progress.
situations.progress.quality: Tooltip of the accuracy counter. {n} is the accuracy in percent.
situations.progress.speed: Tooltip of the speed counter. {n} is the characters per minute.
situations.progress.storyStars: Tooltip of a story's stars. {n} is the number of stars.
situations.progress.lastToday: Line under the progress when the child trained today.
situations.progress.lastYesterday: Line under the progress when the child trained yesterday.
situations.progress.lastDays: Line under the progress. {n} is the days since the last training.
situations.progress.never: Line under the progress when the child has not trained yet.
situations.progress.week: Line under the progress. {n} is the minutes in the last 7 days.
situations.progress.storiesTitle: Heading above the story rows in the progress.
situations.progress.badges: Heading of the world badges shelf in the progress. Its longer words (4 letters or more) are secret words too: typed on the My progress page they start the badge show.
situations.progress.badgeNone: Short faded line in the world badges shelf when no world has a badge yet.
situations.progress.rangeAwards: Heading of the shelf with things from the target ranges.
situations.progress.rhythmTitle: Heading of the My progress section with the rhythm notes from the Rytmus game.
situations.progress.rhythmNotes: The count at the end of the rhythm notes row and its tooltip; {n} notes; one fades for every three days without a Rytmus round.
situations.progress.rhythmNone: Line in the rhythm section while the child has no note: how to earn one.
situations.progress.rhythmNoteTip: Tooltip of a rhythm note: the world it was earned in; a click plays that world's music and chooses it for the World map.
situations.progress.parrots: Tooltip over the parrot count in the progress's top row: {n} at home now, {best} the most at once.
situations.progress.parrotCount: Short text next to the parrot icon in the progress's top row, e.g. "2 max 5": {n} at home now, {best} the most at once.
situations.progress.parrotsEarned: Tooltip over the count of all parrots won in the progress's third row: every parrot round won since the start. {n} is the count.
situations.progress.starsEarned: Tooltip over the count of all stars earned in the progress's third row: every run counts, replays too. {n} is the count.
situations.progress.rangeRecord: Tooltip over the target range record in the progress's third row (shown once there is one). {n} is the points, {date} the day it was set.
situations.progress.chars14: Tooltip of the letters counter. {n} is the letters in 14 days.
situations.progress.days14: Tooltip of the days counter in the progress's 14-day row. {n} is the days with any typing in the last 14 days, today included.
situations.progress.time14: Tooltip of the typing time counter in the progress's 14-day row. {time} is the time in full, e.g. "45 min" or "1 h 25 min".
situations.progress.timeMin: Typing time under an hour, short, e.g. "45 min". {m} is the minutes.
situations.progress.timeHours: Typing time of an hour or more beside the clock icon, short, e.g. "1 h 25". {h} hours, {m} minutes.
situations.progress.timeHoursFull: Typing time of an hour or more in the tooltip, e.g. "1 h 25 min". {h} hours, {m} minutes.
situations.stats.title: Heading of the Keys tab: the keyboard map with coloured keys.
situations.stats.intro: Intro of the Keys tab. {n} is how many of the latest presses count.
situations.stats.empty: Intro of the Keys tab when the child has not played yet.
situations.stats.super: Key colour legend: the key goes very well, the best band.
situations.stats.good: Key colour legend: the key goes well.
situations.stats.ok: Key colour legend: the key is almost good.
situations.stats.practice: Key colour legend: the key needs practice.
situations.stats.bandFrom: Tooltip of the best band of the key colour legend; {from} is the lowest accuracy in per cent, {n} the presses counted (100).
situations.stats.bandBetween: Tooltip of a middle band of the key colour legend; {from} and {to} are its accuracy bounds in per cent, {n} the presses counted (100).
situations.stats.bandUnder: Tooltip of the lowest band of the key colour legend; {to} is the accuracy it stays under in per cent, {n} the presses counted (100).
situations.stats.practiceKeys: Heading of the list of keys to practise.
situations.stats.keyLine: Row of a weak key, followed by the finger. {acc} is the accuracy in percent.
situations.stats.drill: Button under the keys to practise and on the keyboard check's end card: a two-minute practice of those keys.
situations.stats.drillTip: Tooltip of that button. {keys} lists the keys.
situations.stats.clickKey: Hint under the keyboard until the child taps a key.
situations.stats.fingerLine: Row in the key detail, followed by the finger.
situations.stats.keyNoData: Key detail when the key was never pressed.
situations.stats.keyAccuracy: Key detail. {acc} is the accuracy in percent over the latest {n} presses.
situations.stats.keySpeed: Key detail. {s} is the usual press time in seconds.
situations.stats.keyTotal: Key detail. {n} is the total number of presses.
situations.stats.keyConfused: Key detail, followed by the keys the child presses by mistake.
situations.stats.keyNoConfusion: Key detail when the child mixes it up with no other key.
situations.stats.keyAccuracyTrend: Heading of the day-by-day accuracy chart of a key.
situations.stats.keySpeedTrend: Heading of the day-by-day press time chart of a key.
situations.stats.keyHistorySoon: Key detail until there is data for at least two days.
situations.stats.drillKey: Button in the key detail: a two-minute practice of that key.
situations.stats.drillKeyTip: Tooltip of that button. {key} is the key.
situations.stats.medals: Heading of the medals shelf in the progress.
situations.stats.medalsHint: One line under the medals heading in the progress: what a medal is given for.
situations.stats.shifted: Label of the key under the left Shift that latches the symbols typed with Shift, like Caps Lock.
situations.stats.whole: Heading of the view of how the whole keyboard goes (opened by the key with a keyboard under the right Shift).
situations.stats.wholeTip: Tooltip of the key with a keyboard under the right Shift: shows how the whole keyboard goes.
situations.stats.wholeAccuracy: Whole keyboard view. {acc} is the mean accuracy of the keys in percent.
situations.stats.wholeSpeed: Whole keyboard view. {letters} is the usual speed, e.g. "120 letters" (end.letters).
situations.stats.wholeKeys: Whole keyboard view: how many keys with presses the numbers count. {n} is the number.
situations.cert.button: Button in the parent overview: opens the certificate.
situations.cert.print: Button under the certificate: prints it.
situations.cert.title: Big heading of the certificate.
situations.cert.subtitle: Subheading of the certificate under the heading.
situations.cert.awarded: Sentence before the child's name on the certificate.
situations.cert.keys: Label of a number on the certificate: keys mastered.
situations.cert.accuracy: Label of a number on the certificate: accuracy.
situations.cert.speed: Label of a number on the certificate: speed.
situations.cert.stars: Label of a number on the certificate: stars, the best of each level together.
situations.cert.starsEarned: Label of a number on the certificate, under the stacked stars: all stars earned since the start, every replay counted; short, it fits one line.
situations.cert.stories: Heading of the progress in the stories on the certificate (each story with its worlds done).
situations.cert.date: Date at the signature of the certificate. {date} is today's date.
situations.cert.sign: Signature on the certificate (the app's name).
situations.cert.signParrot: Signature on the certificate under the parrot (Aro's name).
situations.cert.precise: Added after the praise on the certificate when accuracy is at least 95 %.
situations.cert.careful: Added after the praise on the certificate when accuracy is at least 85 %.
situations.cert.praise: Praise on the certificate. One sentence is chosen by how many keys are mastered (from fewest to most). {name} is the child's nickname.
situations.super.help.*: Super help in a level, only for the super account: the lifebuoy button and its menu. The game then types like a real player, with the chosen number of mistakes (a wrong key) and hesitations (a word not finished in time).
situations.super.badge: Label of the super account star and heading of the service menu.
situations.super.companionName: Name of the super account character.
situations.service.end: Service menu item: ends super mode.
situations.service.lockRemovedAt: Warning in the settings when the super account removed the password. {date} is the date and time.
situations.service.fill: Service menu item and heading of the dialog for filling in progress.
situations.service.fillHint: Explanation in the dialog for filling in progress.
situations.service.fillKeys: Field label in the fill-in dialog. {n} is the highest possible number.
situations.service.fillWorld: Field label in the fill-in dialog.
situations.service.noWorld: Choice in the world list of the fill-in dialog.
situations.service.fillStars: Field label in the fill-in dialog.
situations.service.fillAccuracy: Field label in the fill-in dialog.
situations.service.fillRanges: Field label in the fill-in dialog: share of the rare things found at target ranges.
situations.service.fillKeysHint: Short line under a field in the fill-in dialog.
situations.service.fillWorldHint: Short line under a field in the fill-in dialog.
situations.service.fillStarsHint: Short line under a field in the fill-in dialog. {n} is the most stars of a level.
situations.service.fillAccuracyHint: Short line under a field in the fill-in dialog.
situations.service.fillRangesHint: Short line under a field in the fill-in dialog.
situations.service.fillParrots: Checkbox in the fill-in dialog: every finished world's parrot at home.
situations.service.fillParrotsHint: Short line under the parrots checkbox in the fill-in dialog.
situations.service.filled: Short message after the progress is filled in.
situations.service.parrotAway: Service menu item: a random parrot at home flies away (shown on the map).
