situations.story.launchCountdown: The standing rocket's answer to the last command of the hero's journey's take-off: the countdown starts.
situations.story.launchCount: The countdown before the rocket lifts off, one shout each, in order.
situations.end.journeyHome.dragon: Green line on the end card the first time the dragon story's hero's journey is finished.
situations.camera.error.denied: Scanning: error when the browser did not allow the camera.
situations.camera.error.none: Scanning: error when the device has no camera.
situations.camera.error.insecure: Scanning: error when the page is not served over HTTPS.
situations.camera.error.failed: Scanning: error when the camera failed to start for another reason.
situations.camera.preview: Name of the live camera picture, read by screen readers (the teacher's scan, the Tasks page, noting a task on a phone).
situations.camera.starting: Status line while the camera is starting.
situations.task.gameLabel: Task form and task summary: label of the game the task plays.
situations.task.game.*: The name of one of the games a task can play, in the form, the lists and the task summary.
situations.task.words: Task form: label of the field with the task's words (for the words games).
situations.task.wordsHint: Task form: the explanation under the words field.
situations.task.text: Task form: label of the field with the task's text (for the text games).
situations.task.limit: Task form and task summary: label of the choice of when the task ends.
situations.task.limits.*: One of the limits of a task (when it ends), in the form and in the task summary, where the minutes follow it.
situations.task.limitHint: Task form: the explanation of the three limits under the choice.
situations.task.dictionary: Task form: checkbox, words from the dictionary come when the task's words run out.
situations.task.dictionaryHint: Task form: the explanation under the dictionary checkbox.
situations.task.knownOnly: Task form: checkbox, only words with letters the student knows.
situations.task.knownOnlyHint: Task form: the explanation under the known letters checkbox.
situations.task.world: Task form: label of the choice of the world behind the task.
situations.task.worlds.*: Task form: one of the choices of the world: the student's current one or a random one.
situations.task.worldHint: Task form: the explanation under the world choice.
situations.task.save: Task form: the button that saves a changed task.
situations.task.cancelEdit: Task form: the button that stops changing a task and empties the form.
situations.task.groupShort: Task panel: the short label of the task's group.
situations.task.resultCaption: Caption over the big QR code of a task's result. {title} is the task name.
situations.task.pageTitle: The player's Tasks page: its title, and the map button that opens it.
situations.task.scan: Tasks page: the button that opens the camera to read a task's QR code.
situations.task.scanHint: Status line under the camera while it waits for a task's QR code.
situations.task.paste: Tasks page: the name of the field for a pasted task link or code (for screen readers).
situations.task.pastePlaceholder: Tasks page: the hint in the empty field for a task link or code.
situations.task.add: Tasks page: the button that adds the pasted task.
situations.task.notTask: Shown when the camera or the pasted text is not a task code.
situations.task.mine: Tasks page: heading of the player's list of tasks.
situations.task.noneYet: Tasks page: text when the player has no task yet.
situations.task.textLeft: Tasks page: state of an unfinished task that ends when its whole text is typed.
situations.task.ready: Get-ready card before a teacher's task (its title is the card's title): what to do; accuracy matters more than speed, and it can be tried again.
situations.task.needLetters: Card before a teacher's task when every word of it has letters the child has not learned yet; its one button goes back.
situations.task.bestLine: Tasks page: the best run of a finished task. {date} is the date, {min} the minutes, {acc} the accuracy in percent, {cpm} the rhythm.
situations.task.play: Tasks page: the button that plays an unfinished task.
situations.task.replay: Tasks page: the button that plays a finished task again.
situations.task.qr: Tasks page: the button that shows a finished task's result as a big QR code.
situations.task.result.button: Tasks page: the button that opens the best result of a finished task.
situations.task.result.*: The small window with a task's best result: one of its labels, or the line about playing again.
situations.task.remove: Tasks page: the button that removes a task, and the confirming button in the question.
situations.task.removeTitle: Tasks page: the question before a task is removed.
situations.task.removeText: Tasks page: the text of the question before a task is removed. {title} is the task name.
situations.start.note.title: Big button on the start screen of a phone without a keyboard: noting a task from the teacher.
situations.start.note.sub: Smaller text under the new task button.
situations.note.send: Phone, a noted task: the button that opens the phone's share sheet with the task's link.
situations.note.email: Phone, a noted task: the button that writes an e-mail with the task's link.
situations.note.again: Phone, a noted task: the button back to the camera for another task.
situations.note.noted: Phone, under the camera: heading of the list of tasks noted so far.
situations.note.remove: Phone, the list of noted tasks: the X that removes one (for screen readers).
situations.note.subject: Subject of the e-mail with a noted task. {title} is the task name.
situations.note.body: The line before the task's link in the e-mail and the share sheet.
situations.map.teacher.placement.*: Ms Turtle on the map asks whether to check what the player already knows: on the first visit of a new player ("first", {name} is the nickname) or once after a very good first level ("offer"). Then the buttons, the honest question about typing with all fingers without looking, Yes and No, and the kind line after No.
situations.level.placement: Title of the keyboard check in the top bar.
situations.level.placementStart: Text on the get-ready card before the keyboard check: type calmly with all ten fingers, what the check does, no hurry. **bold** marks the stressed parts.
situations.level.placementDone: Short line on the panel when the keyboard check is over.
situations.end.placement: Title of the keyboard check end card.
situations.end.placementLetters: Under the picture: how many keys the player can use now. {n} is the number.
situations.end.placementOpened: Green line: how many new keys the check opened; the map shows the new worlds. {n} is the number.
situations.end.placementStrong: Row label: the keys that went best in this check (shown as key caps).
situations.end.placementWeak: Row label: the keys to practise after this check (shown as key caps).
situations.end.placementNoWeak: Row value when no key needs practice.
situations.end.placementSignal: Row label seen only in super mode: the two numbers of the finger signal. Short and technical.
situations.end.placementEyes: Yellow line when the timing looked like the eyes still look for the keys: kind, never "you failed".
situations.stats.placement: Button under the keyboard in My progress, Keys tab: starts the keyboard check.
situations.stats.placementTip: Tooltip of that button: how long it takes and that it only ever adds keys.
situations.parent.placement: Settings, Keys tab: button that starts the keyboard check for the player.
situations.parent.placementHint: Hint under that button: what the check does and what it never does.
situations.kbSettings.tip: Tooltip of the keyboard settings button under the on-screen keyboard, the start of its name in the key-choosing window, and the name of its panel.
situations.kbSettings.label: Screen reader name of that button; {layout} is the layout's full name, {fingering} the fingering's name.
situations.kbSettings.title: Heading of the small panel that opens from the keyboard settings button.
situations.kbSettings.layout: In that panel: the label of the keyboard layout select.
situations.kbSettings.layoutHint: In that panel: one line under the layout select on how to tell the layouts apart.
situations.kbSettings.fingering: In that panel: the label of the two fingering choices.
situations.kbSettings.ergonomicHint: In the keyboard settings panel: one line under the fingering choices while the ergonomic one is chosen, what it is in short.
situations.kbSettings.standardHint: In the keyboard settings panel: one line under the fingering choices while the standard one is chosen, what it is in short.
situations.kbSettings.guide: In that panel: the switch that shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (as F2).
situations.kbSettings.hands: In that panel: the label of the choices for the outline hands on the keyboard.
situations.kbSettings.more: In that panel: the link to the help's paragraph on the fingerings.
situations.kbSettings.ask: Tooltip over the keyboard settings button for ten seconds when the keys typed look like another layout; {layout} is that layout's full name.
situations.fingering.*: Name of a fingering (which finger presses the digit keys) on its choice in the keyboard settings panel and in screen reader names.
situations.fingeringShort.*: Short name of a fingering after the layout's short name on the keyboard settings button (three capitals).
situations.handsMode.*: A choice for the outline hands on the keyboard, in the keyboard settings panel: show them, draw them bold, hide them.
situations.parent.fingering: Settings, Settings tab: the label of the fingering select.
situations.parent.fingeringErgonomic: Settings, Settings tab: an option in the fingering select.
situations.parent.fingeringStandard: Settings, Settings tab: an option in the fingering select.
situations.parent.fingeringHint: Settings, Settings tab: the note under the fingering select.
situations.parent.hands: Settings, Settings tab: the label of the select for the outline hands on the keyboard.
situations.parent.handsOn: Settings, Settings tab: an option in the hands select.
situations.parent.handsBold: Settings, Settings tab: an option in the hands select.
situations.parent.handsOff: Settings, Settings tab: an option in the hands select.
situations.parent.handsHint: Settings, Settings tab: the note under the hands select.
situations.help.fingersTitle: Help, Typing tab: the heading of the paragraph on keyboard layouts and fingerings.
situations.help.fingers: Help, Typing tab: bullet points that explain the layout, the two fingerings (ergonomic and standard), how their digit keys differ finger by finger, the standard one's gain and why the ergonomic one is the default.
situations.about.visitsWeek: Help, About tab: after the number of visits so far, how many of them were in the last seven days; {n} is that number.
situations.about.visitsBlocked: Help, About tab: instead of the number of visits when the counter cannot be reached while online, most likely because of a blocker; the counter's link is just before it.
situations.camera.switch: Name of the round button in the corner of the camera picture that switches to the next camera, when the device has several.
situations.rhythm.title: Name of the beat game Rytmus: the node on the map and the level title at the top while playing.
situations.rhythm.start: The card before the game: the child moves a basket and catches letters falling from the clouds at the right moment; accuracy matters most, a missed letter does not; a great rhythm earns a rhythm note.
situations.rhythm.wait: The character's bubble the first time the child presses the right key too early (it counts as an error): wait until the letter is in the glowing catch band.
situations.rhythm.hold: The character's bubble when a letter fell uncaught: everything stops for a moment and the keys wait.
situations.rhythm.goOn: The character's bubble when the next letter has come into the middle of the band after a miss: the game waits for its key.
situations.rhythm.slower: One word over the basket after a catch a little before the beat (between the middle half of the band and its edge): press a little later.
situations.rhythm.faster: One word over the basket after a catch a little after the beat: press a little sooner.
situations.rhythm.early: One word over the basket after a catch at the band's early edge.
situations.rhythm.late: One word over the basket after a catch at the band's late edge.
situations.rhythm.great: Short praise that now and then rises over the basket after a catch in the middle half of the band; one or two words each.
situations.rhythm.phrase: The character's bubble after a phrase of 16 letters all caught without a wrong key; short praise for typing to the beat.
situations.rhythm.accuracy: Tooltip of the accuracy ring in the top bar during the game; {n} is the percent.
situations.rhythm.listening: Tooltip of the rhythm ring before enough letters have landed to measure the rhythm.
situations.rhythm.ring: Tooltip of the rhythm ring in the top bar: {n} is the rhythm score 0-100, {word} one of rhythm.words.
situations.rhythm.tempo: Tooltip of the tempo ring in the top bar: {n} letters land per minute now.
situations.rhythm.words.searching: Word for a rhythm score of 0-39 (the presses are not even yet); kind, never a reproach.
situations.rhythm.words.nice: Word for a rhythm score of 40-69.
situations.rhythm.words.smooth: Word for a rhythm score of 70-89.
situations.rhythm.words.clockwork: Word for a rhythm score of 90-100: as even as a clock.
situations.map.rhythmTip: Tooltip of the Rytmus node on the map: what the game trains (typing evenly to a beat).
situations.end.rhythmDone: Title of the end card after a Rytmus round.
situations.end.rhythm: Row label on the Rytmus end card: the rhythm score (how even the presses were to the beat).
situations.end.rhythmScore: Value of the rhythm row: {n} of 100 and {word}, one of rhythm.words.
situations.end.tempo: Row label on the Rytmus end card: the highest tempo held for a whole phrase; the value is letters (end.letters).
situations.end.caught: Row label on the Rytmus end card: letters caught of the letters that fell (end.ofTotal).
situations.end.rhythmTop: Green news line on the Rytmus end card: a new highest tempo in this world; {n} letters per minute.
situations.end.rhythmBetter: Green news line on the Rytmus end card: the rhythm score is higher than in the last round of this world.
situations.end.rhythmNote: Green news line on the Rytmus end card: the round earned a rhythm note (rhythm 80 or more at 95 % accuracy); {world} is the world it was played in, whose music the note brings to the World map.
situations.help.games.rhythm: Help, Games tab: what the Rytmus game is, next to its metronome picture.
situations.progress.rhythmTune: Line under the rhythm notes: whose world music the World map plays (while a note of that world is left).
situations.progress.rhythmTuneNone: Line under the rhythm notes while none is chosen.
situations.map.journey.welcome: Hero's journey badge tooltip before the journey was ever finished: a welcome to the longer, harder trip through every world of the story.
situations.map.journey.again: Hero's journey badge tooltip after a finish: {n} best stars (plural forms); asks to beat or repeat it.
situations.map.journey.about: Hero's journey badge tooltip, always after the line before: stars come harder there; the help tells how hard.
